Hi. Thanks for using /v/requests!

Want to change the header background? That's super simple, here's how you can do it!

Changing the logo

#header img {
content:url("Your link goes here");
}

Changing the Header Background

#header {
background-image:url("your link goes here");
}

NOTE: content is not cross-browser, but is right now the only way to do it that I know of. Most users here have modern browsers, so you can use it.
